**Breaking News: Mexican Cycling Team Swapit-Agolico Boasts Talented Rider Gabriela Soto**

In a move that's sending shockwaves through the cycling community, sources close to the Mexican cycling team Swapit-Agolico have confirmed that talented cyclist Gabriela Soto has joined their ranks. This development is expected to significantly boost the team's chances in upcoming competitions. According to team officials, Soto's impressive track record and dedication to the sport made her an attractive addition to the Swapit-Agolico roster. "We're thrilled to have Gabriela on board," said team manager, Juan Carlos Ramirez. "Her skills and experience will undoubtedly elevate our team's performance and inspire her teammates to push themselves to new heights." Soto, a seasoned cyclist with a string of impressive finishes under her belt, brings a wealth of experience to the team. Her most recent achievement was a podium finish at the prestigious Tour Femenino de Colombia, where she demonstrated her exceptional endurance and tactical prowess. Data from the Union Cycliste Internationale (UCI), the governing body of international cycling, confirms Soto's affiliation with Swapit-Agolico. According to the UCI's official website, Soto is listed as a member of the team, effective as of January 1st, 2023. Industry insiders are hailing Soto's move to Swapit-Agolico as a major coup for the team. "Gabriela is an exceptional talent, and her addition to Swapit-Agolico will undoubtedly make them a force to be reckoned with in the world of cycling," said cycling commentator and analyst, Carlos Hernandez. With Soto on their roster, Swapit-Agolico is poised to make a significant impact in the world of professional cycling. As the team gears up for the upcoming season, fans and pundits alike will be watching with bated breath to see how Soto's skills will translate to success on the road. **Key Facts:**
